inputs.command:
set -u
echo DIAG_V2_START cmd-20260908-003000-prod-502-diag-v2
date -u +%FT%TZ; hostname; id -u
echo '--LOAD--'; cat /proc/loadavg; free -m | head -3
echo '--DEPLOYED_SHA--'; cat /opt/madworld/.github-deployed-sha 2>/dev/null || echo none
echo '--LISTEN--'; timeout 10 ss -lntp 2>/dev/null | grep -E ':(80|443|8000|8090|5433) ' || true
echo '--NGINX_ACTIVE--'; timeout 5 systemctl is-active nginx || true
echo '--NGINX_CONF--'; timeout 10 grep -rEn 'server_name|proxy_pass|listen |upstream ' /etc/nginx/sites-enabled /etc/nginx/conf.d 2>/dev/null | head -60 || true
echo '--NGINX_ERR--'; timeout 10 tail -n 25 /var/log/nginx/error.log 2>/dev/null || true
echo '--UPSTREAM_8090--'; timeout 15 curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'api8090_health=%{http_code} t=%{time_total}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8090/health || true
echo '--UPSTREAM_8090_READY--'; timeout 15 curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'api8090_ready=%{http_code} t=%{time_total}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8090/health/ready || true
echo '--MADWORLD_UNITS--'; timeout 10 systemctl list-units --all --type=service --plain --no-legend 2>/dev/null | grep -i madworld || true
echo '--ENV_KEYS_ONLY--'; test -f /opt/madworld/.env && grep -oE '^[A-Za-z0-9_]+=' /opt/madworld/.env | tr -d '=' | sort | tr '\n' ' ' || echo 'no .env'; echo
echo '--COMPOSE_PS--'; timeout 30 docker compose -f /opt/madworld/ops/docker-compose.production.yml -f /opt/madworld/ops/docker-compose.deploy.yml --env-file /opt/madworld/.env ps -a 2>&1 | head -20 || true
echo '--DOCKER_PS--'; timeout 25 docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}|{{.Image}}|{{.Status}}|{{.Ports}}' 2>&1 | head -30 || true
for c in $(timeout 15 docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}' 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E 'madworld' | head -3); do echo "--LOGS $c--"; timeout 20 docker logs --tail 25 "$c" 2>&1 | tail -25 || true; echo "--INSPECT $c--"; timeout 10 docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}} exit={{.State.ExitCode}} oom={{.State.OOMKilled}} restarts={{.RestartCount}} started={{.State.StartedAt}} finished={{.State.FinishedAt}}' "$c" 2>&1 || true; done
echo '--OOM--'; timeout 10 dmesg -T 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'killed process|out of memory' | tail -10 || true
echo '--MEM_TOP--'; ps -eo pid,user,rss,%mem,comm --sort=-rss 2>/dev/null | head -12
echo '--LOCAL_HTTPS--'; timeout 15 curl -k -sS -o /dev/null -w 'health=%{http_code} t=%{time_total}\n' https://127.0.0.1/health || true
echo '--PUBLIC--'; timeout 20 curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'public=%{http_code} t=%{time_total}\n' https://api.autosklo.org.ua/health || true
echo DIAG_V2_DONE
